model_annotation: The figure presents two line plots comparing training rewards over steps for two different training sets: "Easy Training Set" (top) and "Hard Training Set" (bottom). Both plots share the same x-axis, labeled "Steps", which ranges from 0 to 500 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 100. The y-axis in both plots is labeled "Training Rewards" and uses a linear scale; in the top plot, it ranges from 0.0 to 0.4 with tick marks at 0.1 intervals, while in the bottom plot, it ranges from 0.0 to 0.2 with tick marks at 0.05 intervals. In the top plot, the teal line (Llama-On-Policy-Easy) and the red line (Llama-LUFFY-Easy) both start near 0.0 at step 0 and increase steadily, reaching approximately 0.35 by step 500, with the red line slightly above the teal line for most of the range. In the bottom plot, the teal line (Llama-On-Policy-Hard) starts near 0.0, rises slightly to around 0.05 by step 100, then declines and remains near 0.0 for the remainder of the steps. The brown line (Llama-LUFFY-Hard) starts near 0.0, increases steadily to about 0.15 by step 200, and continues to rise to approximately 0.2 by step 500, showing more consistent growth than the teal line.
